reason.text: Got an SMS: this month's payslip can be downloaded at this link. Why is it blocked?

explanation: The owner of this domain is nusadigital-portal.test, not the office's nusadigital.test. Official payslips are on the office portal, not at a link from an SMS.
hints: Our office domain is nusadigital.test. Compare it with this one.
A hyphen turns it into a completely different domain name.
